summary: Production screenshot on V2.47.213 exposed a workflow-scroll capture regression: the Domain/DNS group still reported 9 tools, but long-page scrolling/capture visually repeated the same cards because workflow synchronization invoked scrollIntoView() on every vertical scroll. V2.47.214 keeps the mature Tools header and changes synchronization to horizontal workflow-rail movement only, with a regression contract forbidding vertical scroll coupling. No Schema/migration, canonical data, auth/security semantics, updater mechanism, provider/server state, or Production runtime change. Production remains Owner-manual.
